slides.title: Executive summary

paragraphs.text: Executive summary
Enter the US in 2027 via Amazon, the only US route within the board's limits, and defer retail
The US is the better use of 2027's one launch slot, and Amazon is the way in
–	K-beauty won 39% of US facial skincare growth since 2021, reaching $3.6B
–	Pilot units rose 89% in six months, though repeat trails the benchmark
–	The US route builds nearly four times Japan's 2030 revenue for similar cash
A national retail launch would break the board's cash, payback and margin limits
–	Retail-led consumes $20.8M by 2030, beyond the $18M cap
–	Brands at Onsoo's awareness sell 2.6 units a door weekly; 4.0 is required
–	The 1.3 times Amazon halo in the plan rests on a correlation, not on cause
Amazon-led stays inside the cash cap, but payback needs ad costs below 28.6% of sales
–	Each $24 Amazon sale leaves $4.73 after the planned 25% ad cost
–	At the 32% benchmark ad cost, payback slips past 2030
–	Two of three Amazon-first K-beauty entrants stayed below $5M of US revenue
Approve a gated Amazon launch and move the $40M ambition beyond 2030
–	Amazon-led reaches $26.4M in 2030, 66% of the ambition
–	Retail waits for Amazon sales above $10M and awareness above 20%
